text:
Anya: quick sync — thinking about an alternative to heavy reservations: tapered soft-leases with decay scoring. want predictable perf without long locks.
Micah: tapered — meaning lease length adjusts with observed qps?
Anya: yes. short bursts get short TTLs (30s-2m), steady traffic gets longer soft-leases (up to 5m). each lease emits a decay_score used by the placement controller.
James: what's in the lease payload?
Anya: minimal: tenant_id, target_qps, ttl_seconds, renew_count. renew_count increments on renewal and factors into decay_score.
Lia: renewal abuse is a concern — noisy tenants can spam renewals and hog headroom.
Micah: we enforce a renewal_quota window and add exponential backoff on frequent renewals; churny tenants get score penalties.
Anya: warmup handled via tiny ephemeral warm-tokens — not persisted across restarts and revocable, just enough to avoid cold-start latency for a burst.
James: operator split? put bookkeeping in a contract-manager service and keep placement in operator.
Lia: sidecar contract-manager seems safer — smaller blast radius and easier iteration.
Micah: leader election can reuse operator leader lock; read-only instances stream metrics.
Anya: API sketch: POST /v1/leases {tenant: "acme", target_qps: 10, ttl: 120} -> {lease_id, expires_at, score}. renewal is same endpoint.
James: server guardrails: ttl ∈ [30,300], target_qps <= tenant_quota, reject if churn penalty active.
Lia: metrics: lease_count, renewals_per_min, decay_score_hist, churn_flag_rate, placement_mismatch. alert if mismatch > 1% over 5m.
Micah: ops playbook: on high churn_flag_rate auto-throttle renewal endpoint, bump renewal cost, and send SE alert with tenant samples.
James: billing: free N renewals/month, then small metered credit charge to disincentivize gaming. I'll follow up with pricing.
Anya: rollout plan: internal -> 2-tenant canary -> opt-in beta -> default opt-in for best-effort after 6 weeks telemetry.
orch-bot: ci -> contract-manager:pr/45 built, image:contract-manager:canary-20260328, tests:120 passed. logs -> https://ci/redwood/contract-manager/45 :white_check_mark:
Micah: i'll prototype the contract-manager and score fn.
Lia: i'll draft alerts and the runbook.
James: i'll scope billing hook and pricing update.
Anya: thanks, tag me on the RFC. next sync after prototype demo. :rocket:
